# What these ten handoffs did, in a few words

Open with a paragraph on the stretch of the job these handoffs cover, from the oldest to the newest, and what it set out to do, written so someone who never saw the work can follow it. Link the tasks they served, by their issue URLs, and the handoff or compacted handoff that came before them, for example `after [the first ten handoffs](2026-10-31--2026-11-14-compacted-protocol-handshake.md)`.

## What was built

Tell what these handoffs added or changed, in the order it happened and in paragraphs: what a user can now do, which apps and libraries carry it, and where it lives. Link the pages of the book they touched. Leave out the step-by-step story and the checks that passed.

## Decisions

Give every decision the folded handoffs made, with its reason and the alternatives that lost. A later session treats these as settled, so none may be dropped, however small.

## Still open

Name every question still open at the newest folded handoff, with the person it waits on, and anything left unfinished. Write "Nothing" when there is none.
